scope: Continuous listening preparation only: unchanged production fixed-grid OLA and denormalization, same source start/length, one gain across all eleven signals per track. No inserted gaps, fades, loops, time shifts, signal switches, autoplay, musical acceptance or latency qualification.
join_metric_domain: Continuous source/stem/recombined samples before shared listening gain; absolute jump/RMS values are pre-gain and ratios are gain-invariant.
normalization: Existing worker restores whole-track std and mean to EACH stem after OLA; adapter does not restore either again.

flash_evidence.scope: Exact-build runtime selection/geometry evidence; not a musical-quality verdict.
